original_prompt: Create an Ansible playbook that idempotently configures the firewall on a Linux host: allows SSH (port 22), HTTPS (port 443), and explicitly denies all other inbound traffic.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Ansible playbook (YAML)

Task: Create an Ansible playbook that idempotently configures the firewall on a Linux host: allows SSH (port 22), HTTPS (port 443), and explicitly denies all other inbound traffic.

Output only the Ansible playbook (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
- name: Configure Linux firewall to allow only SSH and HTTPS
  hosts: all
  become: true
  gather_facts: true

  vars:
    fw_allowed_ports:
      - 22
      - 443
    firewalld_zone: lockeddown
    interface_name_pattern: '^(en|eth|em|p[0-9]|bond|team|wlan).*'

  tasks:
    - name: Use UFW on Debian-based systems
      block:
        - name: Ensure UFW is installed
          ansible.builtin.package:
            name: ufw
            state: present

        - name: Ensure UFW manages IPv6
          ansible.builtin.lineinfile:
            path: /etc/default/ufw
            regexp: '^IPV6='
            line: 'IPV6=yes'
          notify: Reload UFW

        - name: Reset UFW rules to a clean state
          community.general.ufw:
            state: reset

        - name: Set default incoming policy to deny
          community.general.ufw:
            direction: incoming
            policy: deny

        - name: Set default outgoing policy to allow
          community.general.ufw:
            direction: outgoing
            policy: allow

        - name: Allow required TCP ports
          community.general.ufw:
            rule: allow
            port: "{{ item }}"
            proto: tcp
          loop: "{{ fw_allowed_ports }}"

        - name: Enable UFW
          community.general.ufw:
            state: enabled
      when: ansible_facts.os_family == "Debian"

    - name: Use firewalld on RedHat/Suse-based systems
      block:
        - name: Ensure firewalld is installed
          ansible.builtin.package:
            name: firewalld
            state: present

        - name: Ensure firewalld is enabled and running
          ansible.builtin.service:
            name: firewalld
            enabled: true
            state: started

        - name: Create dedicated locked-down zone
          ansible.posix.firewalld:
            zone: "{{ firewalld_zone }}"
            state: present
            permanent: true
            immediate: true

        - name: Allow SSH and HTTPS in locked-down zone
          ansible.posix.firewalld:
            zone: "{{ firewalld_zone }}"
            service: "{{ item }}"
            state: enabled
            permanent: true
            immediate: true
          loop:
            - ssh
            - https

        - name: Set zone target to DROP to deny all other inbound
          ansible.posix.firewalld:
            zone: "{{ firewalld_zone }}"
            target: DROP
            state: present
            permanent: true
            immediate: true

        - name: Build candidate interface list from facts
          ansible.builtin.set_fact:
            _candidate_ifaces: >-
              {{ (ansible_facts.interfaces | default([]))
                 | select('match', interface_name_pattern) | list }}

        - name: Determine interfaces to assign to locked-down zone
          ansible.builtin.set_fact:
            _managed_ifaces: >-
              {{ (_candidate_ifaces | length > 0)
                 | ternary(_candidate_ifaces, ([ansible_facts.default_ipv4.interface] if ansible_facts.default_ipv4 is defined and ansible_facts.default_ipv4.interface is defined else [])) }}

        - name: Assign interfaces to locked-down zone
          ansible.posix.firewalld:
            zone: "{{ firewalld_zone }}"
            interface: "{{ item }}"
            state: enabled
            permanent: true
            immediate: true
          loop: "{{ _managed_ifaces }}"
          when: _managed_ifaces | length > 0
      when: ansible_facts.os_family in ["RedHat", "Suse"]

  handlers:
    - name: Reload UFW
      ansible.builtin.command: ufw reload
      changed_when: false
